records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Collective* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged: first_project reached day 1, 1 invite sent, welcome call held as scheduled [calendar:14d9f0ee]. But no customer replies to any outreach [email:c6a5d4b1, email:63ec7264], no tickets, and key_milestone still unreached at day 6 with 8 days left, suggesting slow self-serve momentum on Starter.

draft.subject: Next step for Silver Collective
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. You've got your first project created and an invite out, so the foundation is there -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting real work into that project.

If it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and an admin can resend an invite to anyone who lost access to their email.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's left with you.

Best,
Nadia
